findings.title: Preserve the requested column name during result translation
findings.description: With `transformAliasToInputFormat=1`, `BaseQueryBuilder.process_results` renames `count` to `upsampled_count() as count`. However, `get_event_stats_data` still requests `count()` during serialization. `SnubaTSResultSerializer` defaults the missing column to zero, producing zero-valued charts. Preserve the original column mapping and add an endpoint regression test.

findings.title: Substring matching does not establish an errors-only query
findings.description: The eligibility check returns true for `!event.type:error`, `event.type:error OR event.type:transaction`, and `message:"event.type:error"`—verified by executing the actual helper. These queries do not exclusively select errors, yet receive the error-only aggregation. Determine eligibility from parsed query semantics and test negation, OR expressions, and quoted values.

findings.title: Top-event selection still ranks unweighted counts
findings.description:
Only `timeseries_columns` is transformed. Both underlying `top_events_timeseries` implementations select the top groups using unchanged `selected_columns` and `orderby`. Consequently, `field=count()` with `orderby=-count` ranks sampled event counts rather than the upsampled counts displayed. Apply consistent aggregation semantics to ranking and timeseries queries; test groups with differing sample rates.

Tests could not run because Django is unavailable in the environment.
